scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_1: Dust storms on Mars lift very fine dust (finer than flour) that sticks to solar panels and blocks sunlight.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_2: In 2018, a global dust storm on Mars blocked the sun from NASA's Opportunity rover and prevented its solar panels from charging its batteries.
